statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_sessions (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (session_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_login_attempts (bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (bucket ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), window_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
